hardcoding_contract.admission_rule: No pattern enters the corpus without at least one provenance-bound observed example and an explicit exclusion/falsifier boundary.
hardcoding_contract.daily_input: Observed agent work and evidence from the current day
hardcoding_contract.promotion_rule: Structural validation alone yields at most PARTIAL_ALIVE; external parser/planner execution plus replay is required for ALIVE.
hardcoding_contract.transformation: Extract stable patterns and encode them as PPDDL predicates, actions, preconditions, effects, costs, and bounded stochastic edges

patterns.law: Resolve repository doctrine, exact source identity, branch topology, tools, and baseline before editing.
patterns.name: Exact-source orientation
observed_examples: Exact SHA binding in AGENTS.md
PR stack/base analysis before merges

patterns.law: Keep observed, inferred, admitted, refused, unsupported, and unknown states distinct.
patterns.name: Observation is not admission
observed_examples: O to O* to A to R doctrine
Queued Step Two CI classified UNVERIFIED rather than failed

patterns.law: Reproduce and repair pre-existing baseline failure before attributing failure to feature work.
patterns.name: Baseline before feature
observed_examples: qlue-ls and ll-sparql-parser incompatibility fixed before PR verification

patterns.law: Merge stacked work in graph order, retarget dead bases, and preserve declared non-merge branches.
patterns.name: Dependency-aware PR topology
observed_examples: PR 526 to 529 to main
PR 525 to 523 to main plus 522
PR 537 left open by design

patterns.law: Dispatch non-overlapping file ownership into isolated worktrees; integrate centrally.
patterns.name: Orthogonal concurrency
observed_examples: G2-G7 agents across isolated worktrees
Crown, document index, observers, and subsystem closure agents

patterns.law: An agent returning successfully records task completion only; checkpoint and crown standing require executed verifiers.
patterns.name: Agent finish is not promotion
observed_examples: G0-G9 standings corrected from complete to PARTIAL_ALIVE

patterns.law: Repair authority, schema, projector, implementation, verifier, then evidence; never patch a downstream projection to conceal an upstream defect.
patterns.name: Smallest lawful root-cause repair
observed_examples: SHACL shape corrected instead of fabricating standing
Disk exhaustion repaired as infrastructure failure

patterns.law: Represent facts once in semantic authority and deterministically generate synchronized downstream artifacts.
patterns.name: Observe once, admit once, project many
observed_examples: RDF plus SPARQL plus Tera projection pattern
Coverage and document evidence indexes

patterns.law: Verification observes and compares; projection is a separate receipted manufacturing act.
patterns.name: Read-only crown
observed_examples: Coverage matrix split from crown verifier
Seven sabotage cases verified no self-repair

patterns.law: Standing is recomputed from authority, implementation, witnesses, falsifiers, replay, receipts, and exact head by a verifier outside the implementing projection.
patterns.name: Independent verifier
observed_examples: External subsystem verifier
MFW crown verifier

patterns.law: A pass path without a precise refusal path is insufficient.
patterns.name: Positive witness plus negative falsifier
observed_examples: Crown failure required exit 2 and exact refusal text
Coverage sabotage portfolio

patterns.law: A gate must be derived from independently observable state, not hardcoded truth or two fields written from the same variable.
patterns.name: Non-vacuous gates
observed_examples: Replaced constant-true unreceipted-actuation gate
Pinned external exact-head assertion
Loaded declared schemas

patterns.law: No observation and an executed observer finding zero candidates are different states.
patterns.name: Attempted-zero distinction
observed_examples: All 20 observer classes attempted; 65 admitted capabilities
Five classes were initially preserved as not attempted

patterns.law: Disk, runner, network, and connector failures do not become semantic failure or graph failure; repair or route around them.
patterns.name: Typed infrastructure failure
observed_examples: Disk at 97 percent recovered to 96 GB free
Global GitHub commit search timeout did not erase Files evidence

patterns.law: Planning and reversible local edits may proceed, but publication, merge, release, deletion, deployment, or certification requires a receipt.
patterns.name: Zero unreceipted actuation
observed_examples: MFW ggen.sync receipt
AGENTS.md absolute invariant

patterns.law: Re-execute from a fresh state and compare semantic authority, generated outputs, verifier results, and receipt-linked evidence.
patterns.name: Clean-room replay
observed_examples: NO_SEMANTIC_CHANGE, NO_GENERATED_DRIFT, REPLAY_MATCH
MFW replay rail ALIVE

patterns.law: External CI, networks, reviewers, services, and humans are modeled as probabilistic outcomes with retry and replanning, never silently promoted to deterministic success.
patterns.name: Stochastic external edges
observed_examples: Queued CI treated as retryable, not HARD BLOCK
Ferroplan deterministic PDDL and probabilistic PPDDL dual rails

patterns.law: Preserve function, fence valid behavior, define calculus, exclusions, falsifier, extension, and operational proof before replacing a surface.
patterns.name: Fence before replacement
observed_examples: PR 537 preserved because its author declared it non-merge
Document keyword check replaced by evidence records rather than keyword stuffing

patterns.law: Controlled transformations use deterministic plans; stochastic observable consequences use PPDDL policies; hidden state remains outside the admitted boundary.
patterns.name: Deterministic and probabilistic planning rails
observed_examples: Ferroplan deterministic solve plus PPDDL policy synthesis and persistent PolicySession design

patterns.law: Compare declared observables through reusable adapter families rather than writing one bespoke comparator per capability.
patterns.name: Generic observable-contract equivalence
observed_examples: Exit code, stdout, stderr, filesystem delta, generated bytes, diagnostics, receipts, event order, side effects, recovery
